messages:
Ivy Ramos: Quick thread — I'm polishing the region availability doc to include APAC latency guidance and a Go SDK snippet for region selection. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/438
Tom Becker: Nice. Can we include a short note about typical RTTs (order-of-magnitude) for ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1 vs eu-west-1? Just ballpark numbers so customers can estimate.
Jules Martin: I'd avoid exact ms guarantees; suggest phrasing like: 'Expect lower round-trip latency within the same region (tens of ms) vs cross-region (hundreds of ms), actual values vary by network path.'
Ivy Ramos: Added that wording. Also added Go snippet for region param and a curl example for switching base URLs. Go snippet:
```go
package main
import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "os"
  rw "github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk"
)
func main() {
  client := rw.NewClient(rw.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("RW_KEY"), Region: "ap-southeast-1"})
  resp, _ := client.Generate(context.Background(), rw.GenerateRequest{Model: "redwood-7b", Input: "Summarize: Q1 goals"})
  fmt.Println(resp.Text)
}
```
Tom Becker: Good. Add a tiny migration checklist: update SDK region param, change base URL for custom integrations, verify rate limits, and warm up caches.
Ivy Ramos: Done. I also added a brief note: 'Hosted regional endpoints process and store data in the selected region for standard accounts. For contractual residency commitments, contact legal@redwood.ai.'
legal-bot: Please add link to compliance page: https://redwood.ai/compliance/dpa and avoid absolute phrases like 'never leaves'. The current phrasing looks acceptable.
infra-bot: FYI — availability matrix updated: ap-southeast-1 (GA), ap-northeast-1 (preview), eu-west-1 (GA). I'll attach the internal region-matrix asset instead of the external map.
Jules Martin: Suggest a one-line tip about SDK caching: 'When migrating, allow 10-15 minutes for prefix/KV caches to warm in the new region.'
Ivy Ramos: Added the tip and a one-line curl migration example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://ap-southeast-1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello"}'
```
Tom Becker: Looks good. Approving for merge once CI link-check passes. :+1:
Ivy Ramos: Thanks all — will merge after CI and attach the region matrix image.
